data.one_liner: Accept one-time, subscription, and pre-approval payments through PayHere in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to initiate PayHere mobile SDK payments natively without redirecting users to a web browser. Supports one-time payments, recurring subscriptions, pre-approvals, and hold-on-card transactions.
use_when: You need to integrate the PayHere payment gateway in a Flutter mobile app.
You want to process subscriptions or one-time payments natively inside the app.
avoid_when: You are using a payment gateway other than PayHere.
You only need web-based checkout integration without native mobile SDK bindings.
strengths: Enables in-app payments via PayHere without web browser redirection
Supports multiple transaction types including subscriptions, tokenization, and holds
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration on both Android and iOS
Payment verification requires setting up a separate server endpoint for asynchronous notifications
data.setup_notes: Requires adding JitPack Maven repository and ProGuard rules for Android, running pod install for iOS, whitelisting the app package name in the PayHere merchant account, and configuring a backend notification URL.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are using Stripe instead of PayHere as your payment gateway.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you want to use official Apple App Store and Google Play Store in-app purchases rather than a third-party gateway.
